case_name: Master Arya Selvakumar Priya vs Joint Secretary (Psp) And Chief ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Master Arya Selvakumar Priya, son of Dr. Priya Durairaj Selvakumar, represented by mother and guardian
parties.respondent_defendant: Joint Secretary (Psp) And Chief Passport Officer, Ministry of External Affairs, Regional Passport Officer, Bengaluru, Union of India, Ministry of Law and Justice, Consulate General of India, Toronto, Union of India, Ministry of Home Affairs

facts_of_case: Petitioner is a 12-year-old son seeking to quash an order declining to grant him an Indian passport. He has sought the intervention of this court.

legal_principles.principle: A person born in India on several circumstances is a citizen of India.
legal_principles.held: Section 3 provides acquisition of citizenship where both the parents are citizens of India or one of whose parents is a citizen of India and the other is not an illegal migrant at the time of his/her birth.

legal_principles.principle: Jus soli - by birth a person becomes a citizen of India.
legal_principles.held: This fact and the interpretation cannot be in dispute.

outcome.final_order: The petitioners' writ petition is allowed and the impugned order dated 12-01-2022 is quashed.
